description: This file is a shell script used for testing the Gitweb web interface. It contains test cases that simulate HTTP requests to verify the correct behavior of Gitweb features such as snapshots, modification times, load checking, and argument validation.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets prerequisites for specific tests based on Perl modules availability.

methods.name: gitweb_run
methods.description: Executes Gitweb with specific parameters and captures output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with certain conditions.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the current test completes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock for timestamp-based tests.
